title: Service Advisor
description:
Service Advisor

Franchised Motor Dealership - Warrington

Our client, a well established franchised dealer group, is looking to recruit an experienced Service Advisor.

As a Service Advisor you will the first point of contact for customers in the Aftersales department, you will check vehicles in and out, liaise with your customers ensuring the best possible customer experience and securing future work as necessary,

Dealing with customers' requirements for service and repair work in an efficient and courteous manner.

To carry out systematic follow up, up-sell and prospecting activities in order to maintain and build the volume of work for the service department.

Deliver exceptional levels of customer service

You will also be required to promote additional products and services as well as working with the Workshop Controller and the Service Manager.

You will have experience in the role, ideally within a franchised car dealership

Further training and development with huge career prospects

Do you have exceptional customer skills or experience in a customer service advisor role?

Working hours/days:

Mon - Fri - 8am to 6pm

1 in 2 Saturday mornings

Salary:

£31k Basic + Bonus

Company Benefits:

Enhanced Annual Leave

Company Sick Pay

Career Development

Time and a half for Overtime

Long Service Awards

Discounted Car Schemes

Discount and Saving Scheme

Staff Retention Rewards

Employee of the Month

Company Events and Gifts

Company Apartment in Spain for you and your family

Bonus & Commission

Pension Options

Free Flue Jabs and Eye Tests

Confidential Wellness Support

Free Tea and Coffee

Apply in confidence with an up to date CV!

Who are you applying to?

The Solution Automotive Recruitment have been placing candidates into the UK Motor Trade since 1999. We have a fantastic relationship with all our clients and candidates across the country, many very long standing relationships. If you are skilled and experienced Automotive candidate, we want to hear from you and rest assured, you'll be dealing with a person, not just a consultant!

Unfortunately due to the volume of applications we get, we can only respond to the candidates who match the criteria set for this vacancy. We will retain your CV on our database and make contact as and when suitable vacancies arise. We will NEVER send your CV anywhere without your permission

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant (12-Month Fixed Term Contract)
- Birchwood, Warrington
- Up to £35,000 + Excellent Benefits
- Early Finish Every Friday

Are you an experienced Accounts Assistant looking for your next opportunity within a friendly and supportive finance team? This is an excellent chance to join a well-established and growing business in Birchwood on a 12-month fixed-term contract, where you'll play a key role in supporting the day-to-day financial operations of the company.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Maintaining accurate financial records and processing daily accounting transactions.
- Supporting payroll administration by collating and validating employee information for weekly payroll runs.
- Performing balance sheet reconciliations and investigating any variances identified.
- Monitoring intercompany transactions and ensuring accounts are reconciled accurately between group entities.
- Assisting with the preparation of management information and financial reports for internal stakeholders.
- Processing journals and supporting month-end close activities.
- Reviewing VAT and other tax-related account balances, identifying and resolving discrepancies where necessary.

Requirements:
- Previous experience within an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or Assistant Accountant position.
- Strong reconciliation skills and a high level of attention to detail.
- Confidence working with Excel and finance systems.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- A proactive and positive approach to problem-solving.
- Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively within a team.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a leading organisation, please do not hesitate to apply.

title: Customer Service Advisor - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 02/11/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Graduate HR Administrator
company: ARBORVITAE CARE SERVICES LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Are you a recent graduate looking to build a rewarding career in Human Resources? We are seeking a motivated and organised Graduate HR Administrator to join our growing HR team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about people, keen to develop their HR knowledge, and looking to gain hands-on experience across the full employee lifecycle within a supportive and professional environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide administrative support to the HR team across all HR activities.
- Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases.
- Assist with recruitment processes, including advertising vacancies, screening applications, and coordinating interviews.
- Support onboarding and induction activities for new starters.
- Prepare employment contracts, offer letters, and HR documentation.
- Assist with payroll administration and employee benefits processes.
- Monitor absence records and support leave management procedures.
- Respond to employee queries in a professional and timely manner.
- Ensure HR records remain compliant with company policies and employment legislation.
- Support HR projects, employee engagement initiatives, and training activities.

About You

We are looking for someone who:
- Holds a degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, or a related subject (or is due to graduate soon).
- Has excellent organisational and administrative skills.
- Possesses strong written and verbal communication abilities.
- Is proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
- Demonstrates strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Can manage multiple tasks and prioritise effectively.
- Maintains confidentiality and professionalism at all times.
- Is enthusiastic, proactive, and eager to learn.

Desirable
- Previous administrative, customer service, or internship experience.
- Knowledge of HR processes or employment law.
- Interest in studying towards a CIPD qualification.

What We Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Full training and development support.
- Opportunity to work towards a CIPD qualification.
- Career progression within a growing HR function.
- Friendly and collaborative working environment.
- Hybrid/flexible working options.
- Generous holiday allowance and company benefits.

How to Apply

If you're ready to take the first step in your HR career and develop your skills within a supportive organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your CV and a brief cover letter outlining why you're interested in the role.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant (Temporary)

Location: Warrington (Hybrid Working)

Salary: £13.50 - £14.00 per hour (depending on experience)

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm (40 hours per week)

Contract: Temporary, up to 6 months initially

We are recruiting for an experienced and proactive Finance Assistant to join a growing organisation based in Warrington. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes ownership of their workload, and has a strong background in transactional finance.

This position will initially be offered on a temporary basis for up to six months. However, due to ongoing growth within the business, there may be opportunities for a permanent role in the future.

The Role

Working as part of a busy finance team, you will support the day-to-day financial operations of the business, ensuring transactions are processed accurately and efficiently while maintaining strong financial controls.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Bank reconciliations
- Treasury administration and cash management support
- Payment processing
- Purchase ledger management
- Credit card reconciliations
- Processing and managing employee expenses
- Assisting with account reconciliations
- Supporting month-end finance activities
- Assisting with audit requirements when required
- Maintaining accurate financial records and documentation

About You

We are looking for a confident and capable finance professional who can hit the ground running and work effectively in a busy environment.

You will have:
- Previous experience in a Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant or similar finance role
- Strong experience of bank reconciliations
- Treasury and payment processing experience
- Purchase ledger experience
- Employee expenses processing experience
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Good Excel skills
- A proactive and organised approach to work
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
- Strong communication skills and a positive, team-focused attitude

What's on Offer?
- Competitive hourly rate of £13.50 - £14.00 per hour depending on experience
- Hybrid working with 2 days per week in the Warrington office
- Early exposure to a growing and successful business
- Supportive team environment
- Potential for permanent opportunities following the temporary assignment

If you are an experienced finance professional looking for your next opportunity and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where you can make an immediate impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Adecco. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Location: Appleton. Warrington

Salary: £25,000.00 - £30,000.00

Summary:

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established UK haulage business in a varied, hands-on finance role. Reporting to the Finance Manager, you will support accurate ledgers, cash control and month-end processes, with a clear scope to develop your career further.

Key Responsibilities:
- Process high volumes of supplier invoices in Sage 50, match purchase orders and resolve discrepancies.
- Maintain supplier accounts, complete reconciliations and prepare BACS payment runs.
- Raise customer invoices, allocate receipts and support credit control and statement preparation
- Complete bank reconciliations and post cash receipts and payments accurately
- Support month-end journals, accruals, prepayments, VAT returns and intercompany reconciliations
- Assist with expenses, payroll administration, audit queries and finance process improvements

Experience:
- Previous Accounts Assistant experience across purchase ledger, sales ledger and bank reconciliation required.
- Have working knowledge of Sage 50 or similar software, plus confident Excel skills
- Be accurate, organised and able to manage deadlines and communicate effectively with stakeholders
- An AAT qualification, would be advantageous
- Experience in haulage, logistics or transport preferred

Processing Your Data

Bis Henderson Recruitment is a leading provider of recruitment, interim management and consultancy services to the supply chain and logistics industry. Should you respond to this advertisement we may store your CV and contact details and will process this data for recruitment purposes only. Should we process your data, then we will always tell you that we are doing so.

title: School Administrator - short term
description:
Job Title: School Administrator
Location: Widnes

title: Customer Service Advisor - Uncapped Commission
description:
Start Date: 02/11/2026

Full Time Role - 37.5 hours per week

Stanford House Birchwood WA3 7 TH

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our team in Warrington is full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Warrington contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE
- GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.
- UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.
- BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.
- GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.
- FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.
- GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Reception/administrator
description: We are looking for a friendly, organised and motivated Receptionist and Administrator Document Workflow to join our team. This is an important role within the practice, providing an efficient and welcoming reception service while supporting the smooth and accurate processing of clinical and administrative documents. The successful candidate will be confident communicating with patients, colleagues and healthcare professionals, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage a busy and varied workload. You will be responsible for handling incoming correspondence, processing and allocating documents appropriately, maintaining accurate records and ensuring information is dealt with promptly and confidentially. You will also provide day-to-day administrative and reception support, helping to ensure patients receive a professional and positive experience. We are looking for someone who is reliable, approachable and able to work effectively both independently and as part of a wider team. If you are organised, conscientious and enjoy working in a patient-focused environment, we would welcome your application. Provide a friendly, professional and efficient reception service to patients and visitors. Manage incoming telephone calls, enquiries and patient requests appropriately. Process, scan, read, code and workflow incoming clinical and administrative documents. Ensure correspondence is accurately directed to the appropriate clinician or team for action. Maintain accurate and confidential patient records in accordance with NHS policies and procedures. Provide general administrative support to the practice team. Liaise with clinicians, patients and external organisations as required. Prioritise and manage workload effectively, ensuring tasks are completed within required timescales. Follow information governance, confidentiality, safeguarding and health and safety procedures. Work collaboratively with colleagues to support the smooth and effective running of the service. Provide a welcoming, professional and courteous reception service to patients, visitors and healthcare professionals. Deal with face-to-face, telephone and electronic enquiries in an appropriate and timely manner. Process incoming clinical correspondence, letters, reports, referrals and other documentation. Scan, upload, accurately identify and allocate documents to the appropriate patient record and clinician/team. Review incoming correspondence and ensure documents requiring action are appropriately workflowed in line with practice procedures. Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records, ensuring information is handled securely and appropriately. Support clinicians and administrative staff with document management and other administrative tasks. Handle sensitive and confidential information in accordance with NHS information governance and data protection requirements. Liaise with hospitals, community services, pharmacies, patients and other healthcare organisations where appropriate. Monitor outstanding administrative tasks and escalate issues where necessary. Ensure urgent or clinically significant correspondence is brought to the attention of the appropriate member of the clinical team in accordance with local procedures. Maintain a good understanding of practice systems and undertake relevant training as required. Assist with general administrative duties, filing, photocopying, scanning and data entry. Follow practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality, safeguarding, health and safety and infection prevention and control. Work flexibly and collaboratively with colleagues to ensure an efficient and patient-centred service.

description: We are looking for bright and friendly skilled workers with passion and vision. Are you a motivated, enthusiastic and energetic person that we are looking for? An exciting opportunity has arisen to join the busy Community Equipment Service Administration Team, you will be the first point of contact for all enquiries for Community Equipment in Halton, St Helens and Warrington. The service provides vital equipment to support independent living and to help facilitate end of life care in the local community. To provide administrative and clerical support for the Community Equipment Store Team To be the first point of contact for the Community Equipment Stores for both clinical staff and members of the public. To resolve initial troubleshooting problems for Community Equipment to patients over the telephone. To be able to plan and schedule deliveries of equipment using the bespoke Elms database management system. To have an understanding of Community Equipment and its uses. To be able to prioritise your workload in a fast-paced environment To provide a comprehensive and efficient Admin and Clerical support to the Community Equipment Service ensuring the service is delivered smoothly and effectively. To provide a customer focussed service to the users of the Community Equipment Service and to be a first point of contact for Service Users. To ensure that logistics services are delivered smoothly and effectively, requiring effective management of the in-house ordering, distribution and stock control systems. To ensure equipment servicing records are maintained and servicing completed in line with procedures. Principle Responsibilities: To possess full understanding of the computer systems and to fully use the functions required for regular use of the complex Elms system to include equipment detail, deliveries, collections and stock control. To receive and process referrals to the service from Elms online, or urgent phone calls, ensuring that essential information has been provided. To liaise with staff (internal and external) to ensure that prescribed equipment is delivered/collected efficiently within specified timescales. To abstract and analyse patient records/referrals using judgement to provide correct equipment, referring back to professional if necessary to agree conclusion. To act as first point of contact for any problems, queries, complaints arising from the day-to-day running of the department. Liaising with patients, their relatives (often distressed and/or terminally ill) and professionals by telephone and in person to provide non-clinical advice and information regarding necessary equipment and completion dates. Solving queries from patients, professionals and colleagues using knowledge of the equipment, its use & the fitting thereof. To act independently to prioritise and plan own and drivers daily workload, making decisions using knowledge and experience of systems and procedures, routine and non-routine, to maintain an efficient service whilst maximising driver/fitter schedules & managing the waiting list to adhere to KPIs. To concentrate for prolonged periods on computer (almost continuously) while being frequently interrupted by telephone (and office) queries and demands. Communicating complex information (i.e. equipment use, weight limits, codes, availability and any other equipment needed to support use of) to and from medical, clinical and admin staff (both internal and external). To demonstrate duties to new starters and less experienced staff. Providing daily support to referrers (internal and external) on the Elms online ordering system. To manage stock at satellite stores and ensure accurate records are kept for stock issued from them. General Office Duties To copy type standard documents. To maintain an effective filing and archiving system. To open and distribute internal & external mail, prioritising when required To e-mail and photocopy, reporting equipment faults when needed. Bar code & scan documents to assist in the paperless office. To log answerphone messages and respond promptly, recording the outcome of the calls. To assist in stock control Adhere to Trust policies and procedures as directed in training. Make valid contributions to implement changes to improve departmental proficiency (i.e. use of post code area deliveries). Please see attached Full Job Description.
